title: Tanker GKG share z>1 leads STNG abs return 1d
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] GDELT tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads STNG absolute returns (volatility) by 1 day (+), since direction was noise in R2-0002; trade long STNG straddle-proxy 1d [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.STNG.abs_return] (parent: R2-0002)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.tanker_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long STNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: GDELT tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads STNG intraday range percent by 1 day (+); abs_return hit rate 1.0 in R2-0102 was a non-negative-target artifact, so test range_pct vs unconditional baseline [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.STNG.range_pct] (parent: R2-0102)
